profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Computer scientist with a demonstrated history of working in the defense industry. Experienced with C++, C#, Java, and Python. Established, lead, and worked in development teams with focus in Scrum, Agile, and DevOps practices. Strong engineering background with a Bachelor's of Applied Mathematics and Master's of Computer Science from University of Utah.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Teacher Assistant for intro level CS 1410 OOP C++ and Java courses. Lead labs on weekly basis on C++ with an EE focus on hands-on experience with Arduino kits.

honors.title: The Mathematical Contest in Modeling (2016) - Honorable Mention
honors.description: Tackled the problem of the growing number of space debris in orbit by modeling and tracking the number of space debris over time and explored removal systems.

honors.title: The Mathematical Contest in Modeling (2017) - Successful Participant
honors.description: Tackled the problem of the failing Kariba Dam by exploring options available to us and recommending a course of action.
